From April through June, Hanno City Hall grounds will host a trial run of food trucks (kitchen cars) and a market during lunch hours. Food trucks will operate almost daily, and the market will set up once a week on the main building's wood deck.

May vendors include: Nakayama Tea Shop, Assombrosso! Saitama 1st, Yakitori Dining Taka, Blue Tarp, Nazar Kebab, Hanno Samosa and Curry Jutti, Smoke Lodge Hanno no Mori, and others. Market vendors scheduled include: Community House Saiya, Lakeside Terrace Naguri Lake, Ishidaya Cake Shop, and Takedera.

Reservations are requested by contacting each vendor by the day before. Purchases are also possible without a reservation. "Hashira benches" (wooden seating) are available on the main building's first-floor wood deck.

Please note that vendors and menu offerings may change.
summary: 📢 May too! Kitchen cars and markets starting at Hanno City Hall!
